# Photo recognition regression controls

These credited public photographs and existing Burbz artwork are normalized with the unchanged camera adapter (RGB JPEG90, maximum2560px). Original and normalized hashes are recorded in manifest.json. They are test inputs, never player uploads or part of the offline app shell. Public training-image overlap is unknown.

- **herring-european-adult.jpg** — Hans Hillewaert; CC BY-SA 3.0. [Original source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Larus_argentatus_(adult).jpg). Expected: Larus argentatus.
- **herring-european-winter.jpg** — Charles J. Sharp; CC BY-SA 4.0. [Original source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:European_herring_gull_(Larus_argentatus)_adult_non-breeding_plumage.jpg). Expected: Larus argentatus.
- **herring-american-maine.jpg** — Melissa McMasters from Memphis, TN, United States; CC BY 2.0. [Original source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:American_Herring_Gull_Larus_smithsonianus,_Acadia_National_Park,_Maine_(25108091253).jpg). Expected: Larus smithsonianus.
- **herring-american-california.jpg** — ALAN SCHMIERER; CC0. [Original source](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:GULL,_HERRING_(3-21-10)_adult,_elephant_seal_vista,_slo_co,_ca_-01_(4452564947).jpg). Expected: Larus smithsonianus.
- **illustrated-crow.jpg** — Burbz generated game artwork; Existing project artwork; see project LICENSING.md. [Original source](https://yaanbatho.com/burbz/bird-art-cache/carrion_crow_burbz_manga_20260624_v2.png). Expected: reject illustrated bird.
